countries.reasoning: Turkey is the world's leading producer of boron minerals and boron carbide production is primarily derived from this source; data sourced from USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2023 indicates Turkey's dominant position with reliable national production statistics.
The US is a major producer leveraging the boron deposits in California; production data is well documented in USGS 2023 reports with stable production history.
China has expanded its boron carbide production capacity; estimates are based on Chinese industry reports and trade data but less detailed than USGS data, hence slightly lower confidence.
Russia produces boron carbide from its mineral resources; production figures are approximate based on regional mining reports and export data, lower confidence due to limited transparency.
Argentina has modest boron carbide production derived mainly from borate mining; data is less comprehensive, mostly estimated from mining sector overviews and export statistics.
